prompts.stances: Create TEN transparent cutout sprites of this exact armored winged Wyrm Lord dragon humanoid. Five columns by two rows. Same black red gold armor, folded red bat wings, horned dragon head, thick ember tail, red cloth. Rear threequarter upper-right camera, back toward viewer. SMALL complete figures occupying50% width and60%height of cells, enormous empty alpha gutters and outside margin. All wings folded compactly, tails curled close so characters never overlap. Held poses in reading order: neutral ready; smash fist overhead; attack forward claw strike; sweep sideways claw strike; counter raised claw ready riposte; defend crouched forearms guard; evade low sidestep lean; spell palm raised with small flame; preparing both fists cocked; neutral relaxed spare. Distinct articulated poses, consistent anatomy and scale. Full wings/horns/tails/claws inside each cell. No front chest, no human equipment. Transparent PNG only, no background, ground, shadows, labels, text or scenery.

review.notes: Anchors identify visible foot or support-contact baseline, using midpoint where both feet visible. Rear feet can be occluded. Values are visual estimates, not pixel-exact detections. Tail/cape alpha bottom is not used as floor. MasterScale calibrates separately generated damage anatomy to stances and preserves action crouch/height; shared scale then applies. Root must inspect normalized frames before accepting.
